newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly quoted in nearbys.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly quoted in nearbys.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were unchanged on Friday amid light activity in the nearby positions on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, Lacrose-Savage, upper Mississippi River, next week, bid 145 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, bid 125 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi, next week, bid 145 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi, week of August 10, bid 130 percent, no comparison, offer 135 percent, no comparison.
